'''Camellia Town''' (Japanese: '''ツバキタウン''' ''Tsubaki Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. It is located somewhere between [[Mt. Coronet]] and [[Sunyshore City]] and it was featured in ''[[DP160|A Marathon Rivalry!]]''.

While on their way to [[Daybreak Town]], site of an upcoming [[Pokémon Contest]] that {{an|Dawn}} was planning to enter in order to earn her fifth [[Ribbon]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} stopped by Camellia Town, where they met a {{pkmn|Trainer}} by the name of {{OBP|Daniel|DP160}} who informed them that Camellia Town would soon host the first [[Pokéathlon]] in Sinnoh. The tournament would serve as a qualifying match for the regional competition, and Daniel had been {{pkmn|training}} with his {{p|Snorlax}} for quite some time to take part in it.

[[File:Pokéathlon poster.png|thumb|left|220px|A poster for the event]]
After hearing Daniel explaining the proceedings to Dawn, Ash became excited and decided to enter as well. He headed to the stadium along with Daniel to sign up for the tournament, which started later that day. Although Pokéathlon tournaments usually consist of three randomly chosen events, the second course was replaced by a {{wp|halftime show}} for the inauguration in Sinnoh. The first event was {{DL|Pokéathlon|Disc Catch}}, in which Ash used his {{AP|Monferno}} while Daniel used his {{p|Hitmonlee}}. The two Trainers tied for first place, each having twenty points.

After that the halftime presentation began, consisting of an exhibition given by the last year's Pokéathlon champion in the [[Johto]] region, {{p|Spoink}}. During the exhibition, the {{pkmn|category|Bounce Pokémon}} displayed its skills in the {{DL|Pokéathlon|Lamp Jump}} event. The final event was {{DL|Pokéathlon|Hurdle Dash}}, and Ash competed with his {{AP|Pikachu}} whereas Daniel partnered with his Snorlax. In the end, Snorlax was deemed the winner since its belly got to the finish line first. As a result, Daniel won the Camellia Pokéathlon.

Aside from having a stadium, Camellia Town is home to Daniel's training facility where he practices with his Snorlax and Hitmonlee.
